description: List ALL events from a single calendar without filtering. WARNING: Returns all events which can be many thousands - use calendar_query instead for searching with filters (supports multi-calendar search).

calendar_url.description: The URL of the calendar to fetch events from. Use list_calendars first to get available URLs.

time_range_end.description: Optional: End date in ISO 8601 format

time_range_start.description: Optional: Start date in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z)

name: list_events
